ja: ロケで、現場で(スタジオではなく実際の場所での撮影)
example: We shot the interview on location at the client's headquarters.

ja: 撮影終了、クランクアップ
example: That's a wrap! Great work today, everyone.

ja: 初期編集版、粗編集
example: I'll send you the rough cut by Friday for your first impressions.

ja: 本編集版(仕上げに近い編集)
example: The fine cut is almost ready, just a few more tweaks to the pacing.

ja: カラーグレーディング(色調補正)
example: Color grading really brought out the warmth of the sunset shots.

ja: ナレーション、ボイスオーバー
example: We need a native English speaker to record the voiceover.

ja: 絵コンテ
example: Let's finalize the storyboard before we schedule the shoot.

ja: Bロール(補助的な映像素材)
example: Can you grab some extra b-roll of the office while you're there?

ja: 状況説明ショット(場所や状況を示す最初のカット)
example: We open with an establishing shot of the city skyline.

ja: カットアウェイ(別アングルへの切り返しショット)
example: Use a cutaway to the audience while the speaker keeps talking.

ja: ジャンプカット(連続性のない急な場面転換)
example: The jump cuts give the video a fast, energetic feel.

ja: クロスディゾルブ(場面が重なって切り替わる効果)
example: Add a cross dissolve between the two interview clips.

ja: ロワーサード(画面下部の名前・肩書テロップ)
example: Please add a lower third with his name and job title.

ja: グリーンスクリーン(クロマキー合成用背景)
example: We'll shoot this segment against a green screen and add the background later.

ja: ジンバル(手ブレ補正用の撮影機材)
example: The gimbal keeps the walking shots smooth and stable.

ja: ドリーショット(台車で動かしながら撮る移動撮影)
example: We used a dolly shot to slowly push in on the CEO.

ja: パン(カメラを水平に動かすこと)
example: Slowly pan across the factory floor to show the scale.

ja: ティルト(カメラを垂直に動かすこと)
example: Tilt up from the product to the logo on the wall.

ja: トラッキングショット(被写体を追いかける移動撮影)
example: The tracking shot follows her as she walks through the warehouse.

ja: 被写界深度
example: A shallow depth of field keeps the background nicely blurred.

ja: アスペクト比(画面の縦横比)
example: Please deliver a vertical version at a 9:16 aspect ratio for social media.

ja: フレームレート(1秒あたりのコマ数)
example: Shoot at a higher frame rate so we can slow it down later.

ja: ホワイトバランス
example: The footage looks too orange, let's fix the white balance in post.

ja: 絞り、アパーチャー
example: Open up the aperture a bit, this room is quite dark.

ja: ラベリアマイク(ピンマイク)
example: Clip the lav mic to his lapel and run the cable under his shirt.

ja: ブームマイク(棒の先につけるマイク)
example: Keep the boom mic just out of frame above the actors.

ja: 環境音
example: Record thirty seconds of ambient sound for each location.

ja: シンクロ音声(映像と同期した音声)
example: Make sure the sync sound lines up with the lip movement.

ja: タイムコード
example: The client left notes referencing the timecode of each edit point.

ja: レンダリング(書き出し処理)
example: It'll take about twenty minutes to render the final export.

ja: 書き出し設定
example: Double-check the export settings before delivering the final file.

ja: コーデック(動画圧縮方式)
example: Which codec do you want for the final deliverable, H.264 or ProRes?

ja: プロキシ映像(軽量な編集用代替データ)
example: I'm editing with proxy footage since the original files are too heavy.

ja: マスターファイル(最終保存用の元データ)
example: Keep the master file archived in case we need to re-export later.

ja: 撮影リスト、香盤表的な撮影項目一覧
example: Let's go through the shot list one more time before we start rolling.

ja: 成果物、納品物
example: The final deliverable includes a 90-second edit and three social cutdowns.

ja: 納期、対応にかかる時間
example: Our standard turnaround time for a rough cut is five business days.

ja: 修正依頼
example: We received a revision request asking to shorten the intro.

ja: 請求書
example: I'll send the invoice once the final video is approved.

ja: 見積もり
example: Could you send us a quote for a two-day shoot with editing included?

ja: 業務範囲、作業範囲
example: Adding drone footage is outside the original scope of work.

ja: キックオフミーティング(プロジェクト開始の打ち合わせ)
example: Let's schedule a kick-off meeting to align on the creative direction.

ja: クリエイティブブリーフ(制作方針をまとめた資料)
example: The creative brief outlines the tone, audience, and key message.

ja: 利害関係者、関係者
example: We need sign-off from all stakeholders before final delivery.

ja: フィードバックのやり取り、確認サイクル
example: Let's set up a clear feedback loop so revisions don't drag on.

ja: 承認、最終確認
example: We can't start the next phase without the client's sign-off.

ja: 秘密保持契約(Non-Disclosure Agreement)
example: Please sign the NDA before we share the unreleased footage.

ja: 契約書
example: The contract specifies two rounds of revisions are included.

ja: 締め切り、納期
example: Our deadline for the final export is next Wednesday.

ja: マイルストーン(節目となる工程)
example: Approval of the rough cut is the next milestone in the schedule.

ja: 予算超過
example: Extra shoot days will lead to a cost overrun if not approved first.

ja: 使用権
example: The usage rights only cover the client's website and social channels.

ja: ロイヤリティフリー(追加使用料不要)
example: We licensed a royalty-free track for the background music.

ja: 透かし、ウォーターマーク
example: The preview link has a watermark until the invoice is paid.

ja: 仮素材、プレースホルダー
example: That's just a placeholder graphic, we'll swap in the final logo later.

ja: 最終承認
example: We can deliver the master file as soon as we get final approval.

ja: 未編集の生素材
example: Could you also send us the raw footage for our archive?

ja: アーカイブ、保管する
example: We archive all project files for at least one year after delivery.

ja: バックアップ
example: Always keep a backup of the master file on a separate drive.

ja: ファイル転送
example: I'll set up a file transfer link since the footage is too large for email.

ja: フォローアップする、後日連絡する
example: I'll follow up with the client tomorrow about the payment.

ja: 支払期日、期限
example: The invoice due date is thirty days from delivery.

ja: 発注書(PO)
example: We can't start work until the purchase order is confirmed.

ja: 顧問契約、継続契約料
example: They pay us a monthly retainer for ongoing content production.

ja: 下請け業者、外部委託先
example: We brought in a subcontractor to handle the drone shots.

ja: 調子はどう?
example: Hey, how's it going? It's been a while since we talked.

ja: はじめまして
example: Nice to meet you, I've heard a lot about your work.

ja: もう一度言っていただけますか?
example: Sorry, could you repeat that? The connection cut out for a second.

ja: 感謝します、ありがたいです
example: Thanks for turning this around so quickly, I really appreciate it.

ja: 気にしないで、問題ないよ
example: No worries, we can push the meeting to tomorrow.

ja: 確認しますね
example: Let me check my calendar and get back to you.

ja: また後で連絡します
example: I'll get back to you by the end of the day with an answer.

ja: いいですね、了解です
example: Sounds good, let's plan to meet at ten.

ja: 近いうちに連絡を取り合いましょう
example: Let's touch base next week once you've reviewed the draft.

ja: ゆっくりでいいですよ
example: No rush at all, take your time reviewing the footage.

ja: 今向かっています
example: I'm on my way, I should be there in ten minutes.

ja: 少し遅れています
example: Sorry, I'm running a few minutes late because of traffic.

ja: お待たせしてすみません、辛抱強く待ってくれてありがとう
example: Thanks for your patience while we sorted out the file issue.

ja: 気をつけて行ってらっしゃい
example: Have a safe trip, see you when you're back!

en: Let me know if you need anything
ja: 何か必要なことがあれば教えてください
example: Let me know if you need anything else before the shoot.

ja: それで大丈夫です
example: Tuesday afternoon? That works for me.

ja: また後で話しましょう、改めて相談しましょう
example: Let's circle back on the budget once we have the final scope.

ja: また随時報告します
example: I'll keep you posted as soon as I hear from the client.

ja: 確認なんですが
example: Just to confirm, the shoot starts at 9am on Thursday, right?

ja: 楽しみにしています
example: Looking forward to it, this project sounds exciting.

ja: その時に会いましょう
example: Great, see you then at the studio.

ja: また近いうちに話しましょう
example: Talk soon, I'll send the files tonight.

ja: どういたしまして、光栄です
example: Thanks so much for your help. My pleasure, anytime.

ja: 問題ありません
example: Not a problem, we can reshoot that scene tomorrow.

en: I hope this email finds you well
ja: お元気でお過ごしのことと思います(メール冒頭の挨拶)
example: I hope this email finds you well, I'm reaching out about the project timeline.
